limitations: Fixed regular tetrahedron, Haar normal and orthographic silhouette; asymptotic, not exact finite-surplus law. No arbitrary-simplex or higher-order theorem.
scientific_integrity: The analytic proof is self-contained. Finite NumPy/SciPy tests are diagnostics and do not certify infinite claims; numerical coefficients are not rational interval certificates. Historical priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Sharp lower-tail and silhouette-type law for random projected perimeters of a regular tetrahedron
